title: Source-bound fixed irrigation depth/rate unit and SSDI normalization

equations: when the optional rate field is absent, derive input irrate(mm/h)=irdepth(mm)/24 before any SSDI per-node depth adjustment
for irtype=2, divide input depth by the inclusive selected SSDI node count
convert depth to cm by multiplying by 0.1 and rate to cm/day by multiplying by 0.1*24
fixed-event duration is normalized per-node depth/rate and B1 rejects duration greater than one day

scope: pure numeric normalization for fixed-event surface/sprinkler and SSDI applications
explicit versus legacy-omitted rate and SSDI per-node input depth
100000 deterministic valid inputs with duration <=1 day
non_goals: file grammar, unit readers, event date ordering, node-depth search or profile validation
accepted whole-column water/solute mass, event calendar, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: depth, rate and duration match B1.11 source-order arithmetic bitwise
100000 deterministic inputs pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
